import subprocess,json,sys,time,os
p=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'/app/submission/ipv6_replay.py','plan','/app/tmp/max-manifest.json'],capture_output=True,check=True)
probes=json.loads(p.stdout)['probes']
del p
path='/app/tmp/max-responses.jsonl'
with open(path,'w',buffering=1024*1024) as f:
 for i in range(300000):
  x=probes[i%len(probes)]
  row={'probe_id':x['id'],'received_ms':x['sent_ms'],'target':x['target'],'source':x['target'],'type':129,'code':0}
  f.write(json.dumps(row,separators=(',',':'))+'\n')
print('responses bytes',os.path.getsize(path))

import subprocess,time,resource,sys
before=resource.getrusage(resource.RUSAGE_CHILDREN);t=time.monotonic()
with open('/dev/null','wb') as out:
 p=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'/app/submission/ipv6_replay.py','replay','/app/tmp/max-manifest.json','/app/tmp/max-responses.jsonl'],stdout=out,stderr=subprocess.PIPE)
after=resource.getrusage(resource.RUSAGE_CHILDREN)
print('replay max',p.returncode,'wall',time.monotonic()-t,'cpu',after.ru_utime-before.ru_utime+after.ru_stime-before.ru_stime,'maxrss',after.ru_maxrss,'stderr',p.stderr[:500])
